properties.name: CountedEfficiency
properties.definition: Filter efficiency based the particle counts concentration before and after filter against particles with certain size distribution.

properties.name: WeightedEfficiency
properties.definition: Filter efficiency based the particle weight concentration before and after filter against particles with certain size distribution.

properties.name: ParticleMassHolding
properties.definition: Mass of particle holding in the filter.

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: InitialResistance
properties.definition: Initial new filter fluid resistance (i.e., pressure drop at the maximum air flowrate across the filter when the filter is new per ASHRAE Standard 52.1).

properties.name: FinalResistance
properties.definition: Filter fluid resistance when replacement is required (i.e., Pressure drop at the maximum air flowrate across the filter when the filter needs replacement per ASHRAE Standard 52.1).

properties.name: OperationTemperatureRange
properties.definition: Allowable operation ambient air temperature range.

properties.name: FlowRateRange
properties.definition: Allowable range of volume of fluid being pumped against the resistance specified.

properties.name: NominalMediaSurfaceVelocity
properties.definition: Average fluid velocity at the media surface.

properties.name: NominalPressureDrop
properties.definition: Total pressure drop across the filter.

properties.name: NominalFlowrate
properties.definition: Nominal fluid flow rate through the filter.

properties.name: NominalParticleGeometricMeanDiameter
properties.definition: Particle geometric mean diameter associated with nominal efficiency.

properties.name: NominalParticleGeometricStandardDeviation
properties.definition: Particle geometric standard deviation associated with nominal efficiency.

propertySets.name: Qto_FilterBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all types of filters.
